messages:
rene: heads-up — after the canary autoscale around 11:18 we started seeing weird session drift. users who had a cookie affinity are landing on different variants mid-session :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary deployment redwood/service-v2 @ 1911112200 started (weight=10%)
sam: can you paste a couple of router logs? curious whether cookie parsing or the hash changed
rene: sure — here's a snippet. note the bucket_id flip for the same client_id within ~30s:
```
2026-02-14T11:18:24Z router INFO client=cli-4a7 selected_bucket=20435 route=canary-v2 reason=hash
2026-02-14T11:18:37Z router INFO client=cli-4a7 selected_bucket=5123 route=stable    reason=cookie
```
ingrid: wait — why is reason switching from hash -> cookie? cookie should be authoritative for affinity unless header override present
jordan: we've got two affinity sources: legacy cookie `redwood_aff` (format v1) and header `x-redwood-split`. code path in consistent-hash-v2 was changed last month (PR #412) to fall back to modulus(100000) instead of 65536 when cookie parsing fails — that can reassign bucket ids across the keyspace
maria: do we have a repro? maybe client sent both cookie and header and our precedence logic picked the header after failover
rene: reproduced with curl -H "x-redwood-split: canary-v2:10" --cookie "redwood_aff=cid=cli-4a7;bucket=20435" — sometimes router picks header, sometimes cookie, depending on which middleware reads first
sam: middleware ordering bug then. we added the header parser as a separate plugin and forgot to enforce cookie-first precedence in the canonical request normalization
ingrid: that explains it. when autoscaler restarted a proxy instance it had plugin-order=alpha (header first) vs beta (cookie first) due to config drift. so bucket rotation is not consistent across nodes :facepalm:
jordan: mitigation: 1) pin rollout weight to 0 until we fix node config (already doing) 2) force cookie precedence in router config (hotfix) 3) emit metric `affinity.effective_source` with tags {source: cookie|header|hash} so we can alert on flips
maria: adding suggestion for Console UX: show the active affinity precedence at the top of the rollout modal and a warning when changing hashing algo or cookie format — these are cluster-wide invariants, not per-route
sam: small config snippet we can patch via k8s to ensure deterministic ordering:
```
plugins:
  - name: cookie-affinity
  - name: header-split
  - name: consistent-hash-v2
```
(just make cookie-affinity top of list)
deploy-bot: configmap/redwood-router-plugins updated by sam @ 1911112350
ops-alerts-bot: firing alert 'affinity_bucket_flip_rate' (p99 spikes)
rene: after the patch the flip rate dropped to baseline. still want a postmortem and a console change request
jordan: I'll open the infra PR to enforce plugin order in the helm chart and add a unit test that simulates cookie+header collisions
maria: I'll file a design ticket for the Console warning and the affinity source dropdown on rollout pages (low-risk UX)
sam: follow-up: we should probably add a migration tool for cookie format changes so migrations don't silently rotate buckets across the keyspace in future
rene: agreed. thanks for the quick responses everyone. I'll create a short incident note and attach the logs + config diffs. :thumbsup:
